step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents BookMyShow's serverless and scalable data platform on AWS. Data from various external sources (CRM, transaction, clickstream, product data) is fetched by EMR clusters and ingested into an S3 data lake. Glue is used for cataloging data in S3. Step Functions orchestrates transient EMR jobs that process batch data and load it into Amazon Redshift for data warehousing. QuickSight reads from the data lake/warehouse for reporting and business intelligence dashboards. SageMaker pulls data from S3 to train machine learning models for user personalization and audience segmentation.

graph.name: BookMyShow Data Platform Architecture
graph.notes: Handles over 250 million users and 5 billion page views monthly. Reduced data architecture costs by 70% compared to on-premises using serverless and auto-scaling transient EMR spot instances.
